source: Confirmed Employee CARE and Manager REAL pre/post pulse survey

surveys.title: Employee Pre-Pulse (Baseline)
surveys.description: Six baseline questions for the Employee CARE path.

questions.text: I feel comfortable discussing feedback with my manager.
I feel safe sharing my thoughts during feedback conversations.
I clearly understand the feedback I receive and know what actions to take.
I understand how to improve after receiving feedback.
I apply feedback to improve my work performance.
Overall, I am satisfied with the feedback culture in my workplace.

surveys.title: Employee Post-Pulse
surveys.description: Six follow-up questions for the Employee CARE path.

questions.text: I feel comfortable discussing feedback with my manager.
I feel safe sharing my thoughts during feedback conversations.

I apply feedback to improve my work performance.
Overall, I am satisfied with the feedback culture in my workplace.

surveys.title: Manager Pre-Pulse (Baseline)
surveys.description: Six baseline questions for the Manager REAL path.

questions.text: I identify specific employee behaviours when giving feedback.
I link feedback to clear performance standards or expectations.
I provide clear and actionable improvement steps.
I connect feedback to employees' long-term growth and development.
I feel confident giving constructive feedback to employees.
Overall, I am satisfied with the feedback culture in my team.
